summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or tests, and committed nothing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coords computed as padded slice start/stop minus padding offset, docstring Yields/Note added; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter with patch_size prepended with None for the channel, ensure_tuple start_pos, NumpyPadMode mode; GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NotImplementedError on missing len, np.ceil worker split, apply_transform with map_items=False; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc; tests/test_grid_dataset.py added with test_shape, test_loading_array (single-process and two-worker blocks with pinned values) and an extra test_missing_len. Lines in edited files are within 120 characters apart from pre-existing lines in utils.py. Not verified: tests were not run. Risk: pinned patch values are given to 4 decimals but compared with rtol 1e-5, so rounding alone may cause failures; the constants may need more precision. Judgment calls: setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(seed=1234); the class docstring example prints only shapes.
